meta.phase-name: Shared Schema Source, Neutral Generation, and Test-Mode Import/Export

outcome.summary: Added a shared schema document format and canonical-instances document format in the engine package, plus checked-in Escape the Dungeon source files under the new contracts source tree.
Added a generator script so the checked-in source documents produce the runtime `space-vectors.json`, and wired that generation into engine builds and content-pack bundle builds.
Extended Space Explorer test-mode upload/export so the browser session can import or export full bundle JSON, schema documents, and canonical-instances documents without database persistence.
Expanded the test-mode bundle build route and the delivery/authoring build callers so imported schema semantics survive bundle rebuilds instead of being truncated to feature/model rows only.

tests.test: `pnpm exec tsc -p docs-site/tsconfig.phase56.json` reached only pre-existing Plotly and `ml-kmeans` declaration errors outside this slice.

remaining-work.item: `56-04`: wire Escape the Dungeon gameplay and agent-play paths directly against generated schema outputs and verify the playable loop.
`56-05`: finish overlay warnings on top of the new generated-output inspection and export path.
